meaning_of_gate_status: Every audited non-central diagnostic source has an explicit, validated materialization policy. CLOSED_POLICY does not mean every historical raw source can still be reconstructed.

policy_modes.retained_raw: Exact raw artifact is retained in the repository scientific-input inventory.
policy_modes.pinned_remote: Exact raw artifact is not committed, but an immutable/versioned remote identity plus checksum and deterministic fetch route are recorded.
policy_modes.verified_transport: A pinned transport copy is used; primary-source equivalence for the exact EWD extraction boundary is independently recorded.
policy_modes.processed_snapshot_only: The exact historical raw bytes are not currently rematerializable. The retained processed snapshot can reproduce downstream diagnostic execution, but source-to-processed reconstruction remains unavailable.

claims.rule: Documentation and UI must not call a processed_snapshot_only diagnostic source-to-processed or checkout-only reproducible.
